text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Daitaku Helios didn't show up for 
training even after the scheduled time, I 
went looking for her in the classroom, 
only to find—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, wanna just chill and chat till 
then? Then once it's time—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, oh? If it isn't Trainie!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Pwon-pwon! Great work today too☆ Did ya 
need something from meee?"
choice_data_list:
Today's supposed to be training day, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is this really the time to be 
chilling? Hold on, I gotta change super 
fast— Wait, it's already this late?! 
Shoot, this is bad!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so, so sorry!! I for real won't 
ever do it again!! So please, don't quit 
being my Trainy~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she truly regrets her actions. I 
decided to reschedule today's plans and 
reminded her to be more careful in the 
future.
